skills.title: Skills
skills.description: Work instructions for agents (SKILL.md): organisation-wide or for one space. Agents see the name and description and load the text when they need it.
skills.spaceDescription: Work instructions agents can use in this space.
skills.noAccess: Only people with AI see skills.
skills.author: by {{name}}

fields.name: Name
fields.nameHint: Lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, e.g. write-minutes.
fields.descriptionHint: Tells the agent when the skill helps.

form.hint: A skill is text: nothing in it is run.

versions.title: Versions
versions.restoreText: The description and text of version {{number}} become a new version.

import.title: Import skills
import.description: A SKILL.md, or a ZIP of skill folders (one SKILL.md per folder).
import.safe: Nothing in a skill is run: only the text of the SKILL.md is taken.

reasons.fileUnsupported: Only a skill's SKILL.md is taken; other files are not.
reasons.tooMany: Too many skills in one archive (at most 100).
reasons.unreadable: The file could not be read.
reasons.nameInvalid: The name is invalid (lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, at most 64 characters).
reasons.descriptionInvalid: The description is missing or too long.
reasons.contentInvalid: The text is missing or too long.
reasons.nameMismatch: The name does not match the folder.
reasons.duplicate: The same name appears twice in the import.

proposals.title: Skill proposals
proposals.hint: New skills and changes that agents proposed. An accepted proposal becomes a new version of the skill.
proposals.outdated: The skill has changed since the proposal. When accepting you see both versions and settle the text.
proposals.rejectHint: The skill stays as it is. Whoever made the proposal sees the reason.

merge.title: The skill has changed
merge.hint: The skill was edited since the proposal. Compare both versions, settle the text and accept it.
merge.again: The skill has changed once more meanwhile. Check the new version.

skill.not_found: This skill does not exist (any more).
skill.name_invalid: The name is invalid (lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, at most 64 characters).
skill.description_invalid: The description is missing or too long (at most 1,024 characters).
skill.content_invalid: The text is missing or too long (at most 50,000 characters).
skill.name_taken: A skill with this name exists here already (perhaps archived).
skill.state_conflict: The skill is in this state already.

skill_proposal.not_found: This skill proposal does not exist (any more).
skill_proposal.not_open: This proposal has already been decided.
skill_proposal.version_conflict: The proposal has changed meanwhile; it was reloaded.
skill_proposal.base_outdated: The skill has changed since the proposal.
skill_proposal.skill_archived: The skill is archived; the proposal cannot be accepted.
skill_proposal.no_change: The proposal changes nothing in the skill.
skill_proposal.invalid_reason: The reason is missing or too long (at most 300 characters).
skill_proposal.bad_author: Only an agent or the acting person can make this proposal.
